stemEn: A pedigree was provided showing an X-linked recessive pattern of inheritance. What is the mode of inheritance?
explanationAr: الـpedigree في المصدر موصوف بأنه X-linked recessive؛ النمط النموذجي يكون أكثر في الذكور، ينتقل عبر carrier females، ولا يوجد male-to-male transmission.
reasoningEn: The pedigree is described in the source as showing an X-linked recessive pattern.
clinicalPearl: In X-linked recessive inheritance, affected fathers do not transmit the condition to sons, while carrier daughters may transmit it to their sons.

stemEn: An autosomal dominant pedigree was provided: males and females are equally affected, with no generation skip. An unaffected person at the bottom marries an unaffected wife. What is their chance of having an affected baby?
explanationAr: في autosomal dominant disease، الشخص الذي لم يرث الـpathogenic variant يكون unaffected ولا يملك الـvariant لينقله؛ لذلك مع زوجة unaffected يكون الخطر من نفس familial variant negligible وفق صياغة السؤال.
reasoningEn: An unaffected individual in a fully penetrant autosomal dominant pedigree has not inherited the familial variant and therefore does not pass it to offspring.
incorrectOptionsAr: 25% و50% و75% تحتاج وجود parent يحمل الـvariant. الـ50% هي recurrence risk المعتادة عندما يكون أحد الوالدين heterozygous affected.
clinicalPearl: For a heterozygous affected parent, each pregnancy usually carries a 50% chance of inheriting the variant; an unaffected non-carrier does not transmit it.

stemEn: Which of the following statements is true regarding autosomal dominant inheritance?

options.text: Males and females are equally affected

explanationAr: Autosomal traits تؤثر على الذكور والإناث بصورة متقاربة لأن الجين ليس على sex chromosome. وفي النمط dominant يمكن لأي والد affected أن ينقل الـvariant إلى نحو 50% من الأبناء إذا كان heterozygous.
reasoningEn: Autosomal dominant traits generally affect males and females equally.
clinicalPearl: Vertical transmission across generations is a classic autosomal dominant pedigree clue when penetrance is high.
